text:
mika: Hey — org-level Latency Insights p95/p99 lines are dimmed after last night's metrics cutover. Tenant-level panels look fine. ACME reported an SLO alert. Screenshot attached.

sre-bot: deploy completed: telemetry-aggregator v2.14.0 -> v2.15.0 by @ci-bot (deploy d-7782) :rocket:

ryan: @mika can you paste the org and the time range?

mika: org=acme-corp, dashboard=/orgs/acme-corp/latency, window=last 6h. First noticed ~00:30 UTC. Alert: org SLO p99 breach but tenant SLOs look fine.

jordan: adding @eng-sre. Does the internal query return percentiles for org scope? Try the internal metrics endpoint: 

```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://telemetry.internal/api/v1/query?query=percentile(request_latency_ms,95)&scope=org:acme-corp&range=6h"
```

jordan: if that returns NaN for org but numbers for tenant, sounds like a merge-time change.

maria: I rolled the aggregator canary last night to switch quantile-merge from direct-merge -> histogram-aggregate. There is a feature-flag gating cross-tenant histogram merge; looks like org aggregation wasn't opted in. Investigating now.

ryan: ran the curl — org scope returns [NaN, NaN, NaN] across the window, per-tenant scope returns numeric series.

mika: attaching screenshot and alert link: https://acme.example/alerts/12345

maria: quick workaround options: 1) enable telemetry.ff.enable_legacy_quantile_merge=true on aggregator (reverts to previous direct merge) or 2) roll back aggregator to v2.14.0. Legacy merge uses more memory but is safe short-term.

jordan: what's the restart impact if we flip the flag?

maria: flipping the flag requires restarting aggregator pods to pick up config — expect a short scrape gap (~20-40s) and ~+12% mem usage on aggregator nodes while legacy merge active.

ryan: I'll notify CS to tell ACME to view per-tenant panels or add a temporary org-tag filter as a stopgap.

sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-409 - latency-org-quantiles - severity: high - owners: @maria, @jordan

maria: flipping flag now in prod console, restarting aggregator pods. Will post updates. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: flipped flag and restarted pods. Watching rollout.

jordan: seeing p95/p99 series reappear in org panels on staging and prod. Can people confirm?

mika: confirmed — org p95/p99 back to normal. I'll close the ACME escalation and patch the KB.

ryan: follow-up actions: schedule a short postmortem, add automated test for org-level quantile aggregation in the aggregator CI, and add a canary check that verifies percentiles for an example org after deploy. Assigning to eng-platform. :memo:

maria: noted — will open PR with fallback flag gating and add dashboard smoke test.

mika: thanks all, closing the thread once CS acked. :white_check_mark:
